N1.s: Você já usou os %lld cutlings grátis. Continue no Cutling para desbloquear e este cutling fica salvo.
N1.back: You already used the 5 cutlings free. Continue in-the Cutling to unlock and this cutling stays saved.
N1.why: Same as pt-BR: this folder's vocabulary is the Brazilian one (Ajustes, Ative, seus). Opens with S3's exact sentence so the limit always sounds the same; "Continue no Cutling" matches the system's continue choice, and "este cutling" names the item because Siri's prompt does not show it.

N2.s: Você já usou os %lld cutlings grátis. Abra o Cutling para desbloquear e salvar mais.

N3.why: Same as pt-BR: this folder's vocabulary is the Brazilian one (Ajustes, Ative, seus). "cabe mais um" is what a Brazilian says when there is room for one more (a car, a table), and it echoes S6's "Cabem"; Salvo agrees with cutling; 26 characters.

N4.why: Same as pt-BR: this folder's vocabulary is the Brazilian one (Ajustes, Ative, seus). The count is S21's own wording, so 5 de 5 shows the free places are full without a warning word; plain %lld because the order matches; 27 characters.

N5.why: Same as pt-BR: this folder's vocabulary is the Brazilian one (Ajustes, Ative, seus). S29's compact count, then the promise as two você imperatives; "salve este" tells them the one they were saving is not lost; 39 characters.

N6.why: Same as pt-BR: this folder's vocabulary is the Brazilian one (Ajustes, Ative, seus). S15's button verb, in the infinitive iOS buttons use; 11 characters, one over the 10, kept because "Liberar" would give the same action a second name.
